title: CAT 2022 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning - Data Interpretation
subject: Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning

questions.q:
Refer to the passage provided in Question 30.

What is the minimum number of trains that are required to provide the service on the AB line (considering both north and south directions)?
questions.explain: Calculating the total cycle time for a single train on the North-South AB line (including the travel in both directions and the 15-minute mandatory rests at the terminals) divided by the required departure frequency (15 minutes) reveals a minimum requirement of 8 trains.
questions.subject: Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning

questions.q:
Refer to the passage provided in Question 30.

What is the minimum number of trains that are required to provide the service in this city?
questions.explain: Aggregating the minimum train calculations across all North-South lines (15-minute frequency) and East-West lines (10-minute frequency) yields a total city requirement of 48 trains.
questions.subject: Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning
